newsitem.title: USA: KeyCorp has new corporate finance products.
newsitem.headline: KeyCorp has new corporate finance products.

text.p: Key Capital Markets Inc, a unit of KeyCorp, said Tuesday it has expanded its corporate finance capabilities with the launch of funds to provide mezzanine financing or bridge loans to clients.
Key Capital said the $100 million Key Leveraged Capital Fund will support a client's balance sheet through issuance of mezzanine debt to provide growth capital or to finance a recapitalization.
Key said a search is under way for a fund manager for the Leveraged Capital Fund. Temporarily, the fund will be managed by Carleton, McCreary, Holmes & Co, a unit of Key Capital Markets.
The Key Bridge Fund will offer bridge loans up to $200 million to clients who need to quickly complete financings subject to a later refinancing with permanent capital.
Key said the Key Alliance Fund will be a "fund of funds" combining existing and future investments in externally managed private equity funds.

"The establishment of these new merchant banking capabilities is an important strategic step in building Key's corporate financing capabilities," said Jack Kohl, executive vice president and group head in the investment banking and securities group.
